tools.name: get_cycle_status
tools.title: Cycle status
tools.description: Today's cycle day, current phase, days until the next predicted period and the fertile window, read from the Flo home screen.
tools.phoneInstruction: Open the Today tab of Flo ||| Read the cycle day, the current phase, the days until the next period and the fertile window dates shown on screen

tools.name: get_recent_logs
tools.title: Recent logs
tools.description: Symptoms, moods, flow and notes logged in Flo for the last few days.
tools.phoneInstruction: Open the Flo calendar and tap each of the last {{days}} days in turn ||| List the logged period flow, symptoms, moods and notes for each day you saw

tools.name: log_symptoms
tools.title: Log symptoms
tools.description: Log symptoms (and optionally period flow) for today in Flo. Health data: needs the user's approval.

symptoms.description: Flo symptom names, e.g. Cramps, Headache, Bloating

tools.phoneInstruction: On the Flo Today tab tap 'Log your symptoms', select {{symptoms}} and period flow {{flow}} if given, then tap Apply ||| Confirm which symptoms now show as logged for today

playbook: Upload a plain Flo APK to Revyl (APKMirror removed Flo after a DMCA; Uptodown/APKPure have none; APKCube only has a 160 MB .apks split bundle)
Sign in on the cloud phone with the user's Flo email + password once (Auth0 at auth.flo.health)
Run tools as Revyl instruction/extract steps
Map the direct API later: Auth0 password grant at auth.flo.health/oauth/token needs the Android client_id from the APK; data API host is api.owhealth.com

provenance.notes: Draft, unverified. No community reverse engineering of Flo exists (Flo files DMCA takedowns: github/dmca 2022-09, 2023-11). Found from Flo's public web app bundle (app.flo.health): Auth0 tenant on custom domain auth.flo.health (OIDC discovery lists /oauth/token, /mfa/challenge), backend API https://api.owhealth.com (web paths /v1/web_app/sessions, /v1/web_app/users), web Auth0 client ids present. Mobile cycle/symptom endpoints unknown without the APK or traffic: Revyl network capture is iOS-only and Android logcat shows no URLs. Phone executor blocked until a Flo build is on Revyl (set REVYL_FLO_BUILD_ID). phoneInstruction format: '<instruction> ||| <extract>' (convex/revyl.ts runTool splits on |||).
